name: mediawiki/blitzy-skin
description: MediaWiki skin that renders wiki content in the Blitzy web design language

scripts-descriptions.test: Runs the three PHP checks of the zero-warning build gate in order: PHP syntax linting, the MediaWiki coding standard, and file-permission checking. Each step is also runnable on its own.
scripts-descriptions.phpcs: Checks PHP files against the MediaWiki coding standard defined in .phpcs.xml, showing sniff codes and progress and caching results between runs.
scripts-descriptions.fix: Applies the automatically fixable coding-standard and file-permission corrections. Run 'composer test' afterwards to confirm nothing is left.
scripts-descriptions.phan: Runs static analysis using the pinned mediawiki/mediawiki-phan-config configuration. Expects this package to sit at skins/Blitzy inside a MediaWiki checkout, or MW_INSTALL_PATH to point at one.
scripts-descriptions.test:size: Runs the ResourceLoader bundle-size structure test through the MediaWiki core Composer project, because the test extends a base class that only exists in the core tree. Requires this package at skins/Blitzy inside that checkout.
